spare shard copies on which to retry.

Closes #113939

timeline.body:
This test will fail to see the rejection if the GET retries on a
different shard copy, so with this commit we make sure there are no
spare shard copies on which to retry.

Closes #113939
Prior to this change, the test would fail on my CI machine in a few hundred iterations. I ran this change for 2000 iterations without any failures.
Can you please add a comment here why this is needed for future readers?
